errors.evidence: The description states there are six variables/categories, but the x-axis clearly shows seven: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, and 母语.
The description claims the y-axis is labeled '同配系数', but the y-axis has no label. '同配系数' is the title/caption of the figure.
The description fails to mention the names of the two data series ('中介语网络' for the red line and '随机网络' for the blue line) which are provided in the legend, thus omitting what the lines represent.
The marker for the blue line is described as a cross ('十字'), but it is an asterisk/star ('*') in the figure.

errors.text_span: 但在C1和C2之间呈现较小的波动
errors.evidence: The description states the fluctuation for the blue line between C1 and C2 is '较小' (small). This is an understatement, as this is the most significant fluctuation in the series, going from its lowest point (-0.022) to its highest point (0.019).
